title: Structure-aware DJ transitions
summary: A CNN and bidirectional LSTM segment songs for a DJ planner. A checkpoint study traces one recording from acoustic features to cue points and measures the effect of future context.
lead: A DJ needs two kinds of timing. The beat tells you when a kick lands. The arrangement tells you whether to enter on that kick or wait for the next chorus. This project learns a map of the arrangement and gives a transition planner access to it.

media.alt: Feature heatmap and four classifier probability curves for Baby. Verse and chorus alternate three times, with a close crossover near 39 seconds.
media.thumbnailAlt: Acoustic features above the predicted sections of the example recording
media.caption: One pass of the released model on “Baby” by Justin Bieber feat. Ludacris. Each column is approximately one second. Darker green means a higher value within that feature’s range for this song. The four curves show how the model scores each section.
